words.zh: causing confusion and interruption

words.zh: continuous; refusing to give up; firm in action or decision

words.zh: producing a desired result based on truths or facts
words.en: producing a desired result based on truths or facts
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to remove, take out, or take back
words.en: to remove, take out, or take back
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: the coming or appearance of something
words.en: the coming or appearance of something

words.zh: able to move in a quick and easy way

words.zh: attractive or interesting
words.en: attractive or interesting
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: acclaimed; well-known and popular
words.en: acclaimed; well-known and popular

words.zh: to go around; avoid
words.en: to go around; avoid

words.zh: modern, up-to-date, or (n.) a person living at the same time as another person

words.zh: to divide among people or to give out

words.zh: to promote, help, or support

words.zh: full of life, action, or power

words.zh: weak in health or in body
words.en: weak in health or in body

words.zh: a high point of success or abundance
words.en: a high point of success or abundance

words.zh: an invented story or idea
words.en: an invented story or idea

words.zh: to make pure; to improve
words.en: to make pure; to improve

words.zh: value in doing something
words.en: value in doing something
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to change or make different
words.en: to change or make different
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to study something carefully; to separate into parts for study
words.en: to study something carefully; to separate into parts for study
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: something from a long time ago; very old
words.en: something from a long time ago; very old

words.zh: a slight bother; disturbing to a person
words.en: a slight bother; disturbing to a person
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to think about or prepare for something ahead of time
words.en: to think about or prepare for something ahead of time
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to discover; find out
words.en: to discover; find out
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to follow established rules or patterns of behavior
words.en: to follow established rules or patterns of behavior
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to make rich; to make something of greater value

words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to make stronger in feeling or quality
words.en: to make stronger in feeling or quality
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: difficult or painful to experience; not able to accept different ways of thought or behavior

words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: continuing
words.en: continuing
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: an ability, happening, or opportunity that has not occurred or been developed
words.en: an ability, happening, or opportunity that has not occurred or been developed
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to suggest or plan to do something
words.en: to suggest or plan to do something
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to give back or bring back something; to return to the original condition

words.zh: a fundamental element or principal part of something
words.en: a fundamental element or principal part of something

words.zh: to be in a disordered, disturbed or unstable condition
words.en: to be in a disordered, disturbed or unstable condition

words.zh: of great importance; full of life
words.en: of great importance; full of life
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: of unclear meaning; something that can be understood in more than one way
words.en: of unclear meaning; something that can be understood in more than one way
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to express or defend oneself strongly; to state positively
words.en: to express or defend oneself strongly; to state positively
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: very surprising
words.en: very surprising
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: The scientists made an astounding discovery. The fans were astounded by their team’s success.

words.zh: very intelligent, smart, clever
words.en: very intelligent, smart, clever
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to have the same opinion or draw the same conclusion
words.en: to have the same opinion or draw the same conclusion
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: making something appear true or good when it is false or bad
words.en: making something appear true or good when it is false or bad

words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: strong in one’s opinion, firm in conviction, to find out
words.en: strong in one’s opinion, firm in conviction, to find out
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to get the facts or draw out the truth
words.en: to get the facts or draw out the truth
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to be a good example of a concept or idea
words.en: to be a good example of a concept or idea
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.en: to cause a conflict or argument

words.zh: common or routine
words.en: common or routine
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to make a request
words.en: to make a request
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to give up control
words.en: to give up control

words.zh: strong enough to recover from difficulty or disease

words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to produce, to carry; to show; to endure

words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to make something difficult to see
words.en: to make something difficult to see

words.en: intensely bright or colorful; intelligent
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.en: needing careful treatment; sensitive, easily broken

words.zh: to increase in a positive way, such as in value, power, or beauty

words.zh: to make easier; to ease the progress of
words.en: to make easier; to ease the progress of

words.zh: nonstop, continual, or never-ending
words.en: nonstop, continual, or never-ending

words.en: in addition to, alongside

words.zh: to interest greatly
words.en: to interest greatly
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to prevent movement, progress, or success
words.en: to prevent movement, progress, or success

words.en: to change a belief or behavior by argument or reason

words.zh: a repayment or reward for a deed
words.en: a repayment or reward for a deed

words.zh: to throw off naturally; to give out
words.en: to throw off naturally; to give out
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: the most important or most common
words.en: the most important or most common
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: not fine or smooth; not delicate
words.en: not fine or smooth; not delicate

words.zh: ordinary
words.en: ordinary

words.zh: following accepted rules or standards

words.zh: odd or strange; eager to learn

words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to send out; give off
words.en: to send out; give off

words.zh: to bring about the end of something
words.en: to bring about the end of something
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: extremely large
words.en: extremely large
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: enough; in a satisfying manner
words.en: enough; in a satisfying manner

words.zh: can be seen *power of imagination or wisdom, especially with regard to the future

words.zh: to escape in a tricky way

words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: The criminal has eluded the police for months. Success has been elusive for the team.

words.zh: to be in the presence of and oppose
words.en: to be in the presence of and oppose
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: The mountain climbers faced grave danger on the cliff. He finds it difficult to face his problems.

words.zh: element or component
words.en: element or component
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: The proposal had many beneficial facets. It was a multifaceted problem that challenged the entire student body.

words.zh: a person or image that is loyally admired or respected
words.en: a person or image that is loyally admired or respected
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: something that cannot be reached or communicated with
words.en: something that cannot be reached or communicated with
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: The summit of the mountain was inaccessible. The dignitary’s inaccessibility frustrated the reporter.

words.zh: to be unaware of or forgetful
words.en: to be unaware of or forgetful
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: The students were oblivious to the fact that the test would cover the entire chapter. The coastal inhabitants were oblivious to the dangers of the approaching hurricane.

words.zh: in a clear, easy-to-understand way
words.en: in a clear, easy-to-understand way
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: It had obviously rained. It was obvious that he had not practiced his oral report.

words.zh: causing anger; rude; being unpleasant
words.en: causing anger; rude; being unpleasant
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: Rotten eggs emit an offensive odor. Her offensive remarks angered the entire audience.

words.zh: in a way that foretells future events
words.en: in a way that foretells future events
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: She predictably forgot to do her assignment. The government’s predictions were accurate.

words.zh: appropriate; correct; convenient
words.en: appropriate; correct; convenient
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: Her dress was not suitable for the occasion. The agreement suits all the members of the negotiating team.

words.zh: to go beyond
words.en: to go beyond
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: The movie surpassed even the film critics’ high expectations. The soccer player will probably surpass the scoring record set last year.

words.zh: to support or maintain
words.en: to support or maintain
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: more than enough
words.en: more than enough
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: very difficult or challenging; requiring hard work
words.en: very difficult or challenging; requiring hard work
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: being of little rain or water
words.en: being of little rain or water
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to stop from occurring; to turn away or aside
words.en: to stop from occurring; to turn away or aside
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: She could have averted the accident if she had not been texting while driving. The citizens packed sandbags along the river bank to avert the flooding of their streets.

words.zh: to show little fear or regard for rules or established norms; to challenge
words.en: to show little fear or regard for rules or established norms; to challenge
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: I defy you to find that book in the library’s collection. The circus performer demonstrated her death-defying routine.

words.zh: done with persistence and hard work; with attention to details
words.en: done with persistence and hard work; with attention to details
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: Stephanie displayed great diligence in the completion of her assignments. The diligent worker received recognition for his accomplishments.

words.zh: to pass a law
words.en: to pass a law
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to pretend; make believe
words.en: to pretend; make believe
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: able to produce abundantly
words.en: able to produce abundantly

words.zh: caught or produced not long ago
words.en: caught or produced not long ago

words.zh: the normal purpose of something
words.en: the normal purpose of something
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: a primary or basic element
words.en: a primary or basic element
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: not chosen carefully; unplanned
words.en: not chosen carefully; unplanned
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to find or describe something with precision
words.en: to find or describe something with precision
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: carefully chosen
words.en: carefully chosen
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: They were very selective when they chose the members of the academic team. He selected Spanish as his language class.

words.zh: having a lot of room
words.en: having a lot of room
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to fight without surrender; to persist
words.en: to fight without surrender; to persist
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: She cannot withstand the pressures of her job. The old building withstood the terrible storm.

words.zh: to stick to or follow precisely
words.en: to stick to or follow precisely
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: Travelers must adhere to the laws of the country they are visiting. The referee’s excessively strict adherence to the rules upset the players.

words.zh: something that lasts a long time *time during which something lasts
words.en: something that lasts a long time *time during which something lasts
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: It was a durable refrigerator, but it finally broke. The durability of tires is a key factor in determining their quality.

words.zh: to promote growth or development
words.en: to promote growth or development
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: The industrial revolution fostered the rise of the middle class. Parents usually foster the development of good habits in their children.

words.zh: to obtain something needed or useful; to increase to the amount of something
words.en: to obtain something needed or useful; to increase to the amount of something
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: He gained a lot of experience working as a volunteer. His gain in knowledge was impressive.

words.zh: to stop or discontinue
words.en: to stop or discontinue
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to deal with or control
words.en: to deal with or control
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to give protection; to not express a desire or opinion, usually bad
words.en: to give protection; to not express a desire or opinion, usually bad
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: something that causes pain or damage
words.en: something that causes pain or damage

words.en: not important; of little value

words.zh: not easily understood or figured out
words.en: not easily understood or figured out

words.zh: threatening or risky; harmful
words.en: threatening or risky; harmful
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to encourage or advertise; to elevate in rank or grade
words.en: to encourage or advertise; to elevate in rank or grade
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: being excessive; showing unnecessary repetition
words.en: being excessive; showing unnecessary repetition

words.zh: to refuse
words.en: to refuse
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: important; strongly made; of value
words.en: important; strongly made; of value
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: specific qualities that distinguish one from another
words.en: specific qualities that distinguish one from another

words.zh: to make evident or emphasize
words.en: to make evident or emphasize
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: The high quality of the student’s science fair project underscored her talent in biology. The conclusion of the report should underscore its main ideas.

words.zh: showing serious purpose; one who works carefully and with enthusiasm
words.en: showing serious purpose; one who works carefully and with enthusiasm
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.en: to make something known to others; to communicate
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to surround completely; to envelop
words.en: to surround completely; to envelop

words.zh: the act of making larger
words.en: the act of making larger

words.zh: to cause to become greater
words.en: to cause to become greater

words.zh: to emphasize the part of a greater whole
words.en: to emphasize the part of a greater whole

words.en: something that cannot be prevented

words.zh: in the beginning stages of development
words.en: in the beginning stages of development
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to copy an action
words.en: to copy an action
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: The comedian mimicked the president’s gestures. Parrots mimic the speech that they hear in their surroundings.

words.zh: to find and bring back
words.en: to find and bring back
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to be of highest importance
words.en: to be of highest importance

words.zh: to be skilled or experienced in something
words.en: to be skilled or experienced in something
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: done according to a plan
words.en: done according to a plan
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: not probable
words.en: not probable
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.en: without good reason or cause; inappropriate

words.zh: the highest point
words.en: the highest point

words.zh: to shake or move; to cause worry
words.en: to shake or move; to cause worry

words.zh: to be said or written in secret
words.en: to be said or written in secret
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.en: in a careful, polite manner

words.zh: proven with written evidence
words.en: proven with written evidence
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to call up or produce memories or feelings; to cause to remember

words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: slowly, but surely
words.en: slowly, but surely
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.en: showing no favoritism; being fair or just

words.zh: a large amount or quantity; more than reasonable

words.zh: happening immediately; in a short period of time
words.en: happening immediately; in a short period of time
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: The computer finished the job instantly. It happened in an instant.

words.zh: with definite purpose and planning
words.en: with definite purpose and planning
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition
words.examples: The machine was left on intentionally. Her action was an indication of her good intentions.

words.zh: being a primary part of something
words.en: being a primary part of something
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to flood
words.en: to flood
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: an established attitude or mood
words.en: an established attitude or mood
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: very small; in form, but not in substance

words.zh: reported, but not confirmed
words.en: reported, but not confirmed

words.zh: clearly false; without reason
words.en: clearly false; without reason
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: a share; a part set aside for a special purpose; an assignment of portions

words.zh: to find or discover, usually by chance or mistake
words.en: to find or discover, usually by chance or mistake
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: to finish; to reach a climax or the highest point
words.en: to finish; to reach a climax or the highest point
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: someone’s outward appearance or behavior
words.en: someone’s outward appearance or behavior
words.src: Barron’s · Essential Words for the TOEFL · 6th edition

words.zh: having errors

words.zh: able to be done
words.en: able to be done

words.zh: a need for; an insufficient amount

words.zh: ways

words.zh: small from one side to the other; limited

words.zh: showing good health; in good shape

words.zh: quick
words.en: quick
